for superlative: by doubling the consonant and adding -est

big bigger biggest

for comparative: By adding -r for comparative

nice nicer

nice nicer nicest

sections.section_title: Long adjectives with two or more syllables
sections.content_markdown:
for comparative: by adding more with the adjectives

interesting more interesting

for superlative: by adding most with the adjectives

interesting more interesting most interesting

for comparative: by changing y to -ier

dirty dirtier

for superlative: by changing y to -iest

dirty dirtier dirtiest

There are some adjectives that do not follow any rule. We call them irregular adjectives. We need to remember their other forms. Such as

good better best

bad worse worst

far farther farthest
